_description: This config file demonstrates all available options for sample classification
_model_path_note: Path to trained classifier (.pkl file from MethylDetector/MethylTrainer)
_input_path_note: Path to single .h5 file or directory containing .h5 files
_output_path_note: Optional CSV file for results (null = print to console only)
_prediction_method_note: null (smart default: beta for ≤10 DMPs, sklearn for >10), 'sklearn' (fast), or 'beta' (exact)
_prediction_method_recommendation: Use null for automatic optimal performance
_no_filter_note: If true, process all .h5 files without chromosome/context filtering
_log_level_note: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL
